Maya S.: FYI vendor lab returned a note about mixed-GPU racks causing PSU headroom issues (H100/H200 + Gaudi). Could affect marketplace capacity.
Jon R.: Which regions/architectures did they test?
Maya S.: EU-west lab: mixed 4xH100 + 2xGaudi in same power zone showed throttling under long-context load.
Tom B. (hw-partner): Confirmed similar on our side. Recommendation: separate power zones or reduce density.
Priya N.: We need marketplace fallback options and an embargo for joint announce wording.
Jon R.: Options: dedicated racks per SKU, reduced density for mixed SKU, or phased region rollout.
Maya S.: Infra: can we detect headroom and publish a compatibility flag? @infra-bot
infra-bot: Running power sweep this afternoon; will publish /compatibility/power_flag.json if anomalies.
Tom B. (hw-partner): Sending rack diagrams + recommended slotting table shortly. Sample: H100 max2/zone, H200 max1/zone, Gaudi up to3 with zoning, mixed -> reduce H100 to1.
Priya N.: Add UI banner: "density-limited" ) and note in SI playbook.
Jon R.: I'll add banner and SKU flags (ETA Fri).
Maya S.: Propose 2-week canary in one region with reduced_density flag, collect tail latency and thermal metrics.
Tom B. (hw-partner): We'll provide SI engineer for canary.
infra-bot: Power sweep done; endpoint published: https://internal-api.company/compatibility/power_flag.json
Maya S.: Meeting to review matrix tomorrow 10am PT. Invite incoming.
Priya N.: I'll draft embargo dates after canary results.
Jon R.: Recording action items and closing thread unless issues crop up.
